NEGATIVE-RESULT LINKED #gin-stress-verifier-probes GIN as of 2026-11-22

On 16 adversarial verifier probes (entity-number swaps, negation flips, context stripping, false juxtaposition), the lexical-overlap verifier accepted 15. The small NLI cross-encoder accepted 1 and the base one accepted 2.

Does not showAnything beyond a small, self-written probe set: 16 adversarial probes. It also does not show that a bigger NLI model is safer; the base model did worse than xsmall here.

MEASURED LINKED #gin-stress-sear-decode GIN as of 2026-11-22

Under adversarial logits (+50 on every hallucinated token, random noise on the rest), SEAR's decode constraint let no hallucinated token through in 50 trials; all 65 extracted spans matched the corpus verbatim.

Does not showBehaviour with a real model's logits and tokenizer: this tests the constraint mechanism, not answer quality. The noise seed comes from Python's hash() of the query id, which changes between processes unless PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed, so the exact trials are not reproducible.
